description: This file defines an abstract class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform' which provides methods for transforming HTML attributes, including prepending CSS styles and confiscating attributes, as part of an HTML attribute filtering system.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform
classes.description: An abstract class providing attribute transformation methods, used within the HTMLPurifier library to process and modify HTML tag attributes during purification.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Abstract method to process and potentially modify the attribute array based on configuration and context.

methods.name: prependCSS
methods.description: Prepends CSS styles to the 'style' attribute in the attribute array, creating the attribute if it does not exist.

methods.name: confiscateAttr
methods.description: Removes and returns a specified attribute from the attribute array.
